# Ops notebook
Notes from the on-call week.
## Rotate the keys
- Generate the new key pair
- Upload the public key
- Retire the old key
## Fix the reaper
- The reaper skips jobs that finish during a restart
- Reproduce it with a restart in the middle of a sweep
- Patch the cursor so it resumes from the last job
- Add a test for the restart case
## Sweep the logs
- Find the logs older than a week
- Compress them into the archive
- Delete the originals

steps.line: * Given a notebook taller than the window is open, scrolled so that "## Fix the reaper" is the top line

drive.jq:
(.given // .opened).json.sections.notebook as $n | (([$n.drawn[] | select(.text | sub("
$"; "") == "## Fix the reaper") | .offset] | first) // ("# Ops notebook
Notes from the on-call week.
## Rotate the keys
- Generate the new key pair
- Upload the public key
- Retire the old key
" | length)) as $h | ([$n.drawn[] | select(.rect.y + .rect.height > 0)] | first) as $top | if $top.offset < $h then 1 else -1 end

do.until: ([.given.json.sections.notebook.drawn[]? | select(.rect.y + .rect.height > 0)] | first | .text // "" | sub("\n$"; "")) == "## Fix the reaper"

expect.why: the notebook open is the whole fixture
the notebook is taller than the window

expect.that: ([.given.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.rect.y + .rect.height > 0)] | first | .text | sub("\n$"; "")) == "## Fix the reaper"
expect.why: the heading is the first line visible at the window's top

steps.line: * When the user folds "## Fix the reaper"

drive.jq: .given.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.text | sub("\n$"; "") == "## Fix the reaper") | .rect | ((if .y > 0 then .y else 0 end) + .y + .height) / 2

[.menus.items[] | select(.press == true or .press == "press") | .path | select(split(" > ") | last | ascii_downcase | test("\\bfold\\b") and (test("\\b(all|others?|every|level)\\b") | not))] + [.menus.items[] | select(.press == true or .press == "press") | .path | select(split(" > ") | last | ascii_downcase | test("\\bcollapse\\b") and (test("\\b(all|others?|every|level)\\b") | not))] | first

steps.line: * Then the next visible line starts right below "## Fix the reaper"

expect.that: all(.folded, .below; .json as $j | $j.sections.notebook.drawn as $d | ([$d[] | select(.text | sub("\n$"; "") == "## Fix the reaper")] | first) as $h | ([$d[] | select($h != null and .offset > $h.offset and .rect.height > 0)] | first) as $n | $h != null and $n != null and (($n.rect.y - ($h.rect.y + $h.rect.height)) | fabs) < (1 / $j.window.scale))
expect.why: right after the fold and again a second later, the next visible line is drawn directly under the heading, within a pixel

expect.that: all(.folded, .below; .json.sections.notebook as $nb | ([$nb.drawn[] | select(.text | sub("\n$"; "") == "## Fix the reaper")] | first) as $h | ([$nb.drawn[] | select($h != null and .offset > $h.offset and .rect.height > 0)] | first) as $n | $h != null and $n != null and ([$nb.gaps[] | select(.after >= $h.offset and .before <= $n.offset)] | length == 0))
expect.why: right after the fold and again a second later, no blank space is left between the heading and the next visible line

steps.line: * And "## Fix the reaper" is still the top line

expect.that: ([.still.json.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.rect.y + .rect.height > 0)] | first | .text | sub("\n$"; "")) == "## Fix the reaper"
expect.why: the heading is still the first line visible at the window's top

expect.that: [(.beforeFold, .folded, .below, .still) | .json as $j | $j.sections.notebook.drawn[] | select(.text | sub("\n$"; "") == "## Fix the reaper") | [$j.window.frame.x + .rect.x, $j.window.frame.y + $j.window.frame.height - $j.window.content.height + .rect.y]] as $p | ($p | length) == 4 and all($p[]; . == $p[0])
expect.why: folding did not move the heading on screen: in every state read from before the fold to now, its point on the screen is exactly where it was
